title: GROUNDING OR GUESSING? VISUAL SIGNALS FOR DETECTING HALLUCINATIONS IN SIGN LANGUAGE TRANSLATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model reliance on language priors over visual grounding by applying counterfactual visual perturbations (masking or mismatching source video) and injecting adversarial prompt prefixes to observe whether the model hallucinates fluent text unsupported by the visual evidence.
